camel_example: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/ai/conversations --region cn-hangzhou --agentType DataAgent --nextToken 'eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ==' --maxResults 20 --conversationId '123456789012****#cn-shanghai#1ee04bea-0488-46b6-b85b-827e3cd37e55' --keyword '销售分析' --status active --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Performs a paging query on the agent sessions of the current account and supports filtering by status, agent type, keyword, and session ID
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号的Agent会话列表，支持按状态、Agent类型、关键词和会话ID过滤
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute list-conversations --next-token eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ== --max-results 20 --status active --agent-type DataAgent --keyword '销售分析' --conversation-id '123456789012****#cn-shanghai#1ee04bea-0488-46b6-b85b-827e3cd37e55' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConversations

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response. An empty nextToken value in the response indicates that no more data is available
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记。首次查询留空；后续查询传入上一次返回的nextToken。返回的nextToken为空时表示没有更多数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of sessions to return in the current request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次返回的最大会话条数。取值范围1~100，默认值20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The session status used for filtering. Valid values: active (active, default value) and archived (archived)
parameters.help_zh: 会话状态过滤。取值：active（活跃，默认值）或archived（已归档）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The agent type used for filtering. Valid values: MaxAgent (MaxCompute intelligent assistant, default value) and DataAgent (data analytics agent)
parameters.help_zh: Agent类型过滤。取值：MaxAgent（默认值，MaxCompute智能助手）或DataAgent（数据分析Agent）
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for filtering. The system matches the keyword against session titles. Maximum length: 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 关键词过滤，按会话标题匹配，最长100个字符
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The session ID used for exact match filtering. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 按会话ID精确过滤，最长128个字符
parameters.name: conversation_id

data.description_en: The session list and pagination information

agentType.description_en: The agent type to which the session belongs. Valid values: MaxAgent (MaxCompute intelligent assistant) and DataAgent (data analytics agent)
agentType.description_zh: 会话所属Agent类型。取值：MaxAgent（MaxCompute智能助手）或DataAgent（数据分析Agent）

conversationId.description_en: The session ID. You can use this ID to query message history and artifacts, or initiate a conversation
conversationId.description_zh: 会话ID，可用于查询消息历史、产物或发起对话

createdAt.description_en: The time when the session was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 format, such as 2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z
createdAt.description_zh: 会话创建时间。UTC时间，RFC3339格式，例如2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z

lastMessagePreview.description_en: The preview text of the most recent message
lastMessagePreview.description_zh: 最近一条消息的预览文本
lastMessagePreview.example: 已完成近30天销售趋势分析。

messageCount.description_en: The total number of messages in the session

projectName.description_en: The name of the MaxCompute project associated with the session

status.description_en: The session status. Valid values: active (active) and archived (archived)
status.description_zh: 会话状态。取值：active（活跃）或archived（已归档）

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the session was last updated. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 format, such as 2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z
updatedAt.description_zh: 会话最近更新时间。UTC时间，RFC3339格式，例如2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in the current request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求的最大返回条数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty string indicates that no more data is available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页标记。为空字符串时表示没有更多数据

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned to help identify the cause of the error
errorCode.description_zh: 错误码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回具体错误码，用于定位错误原因

errorMsg.description_en: The error message. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a human-readable error description is returned
errorMsg.description_zh: 错误信息。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回可读的错误描述

httpCode.description_en: The business status code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, the corresponding HTTP error code is returned, such as 400, 403, 404, or 500
httpCode.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回对应的HTTP错误码，例如400、403、404、500

requestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID uniquely identifies the request and can be used for troubleshooting and log correlation
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，唯一标识本次请求，可用于问题排查与日志关联
